title: Communication-constrained nonlocal correlations
summary: Identifying the physical grounds distinguishing quantum theory from broader probabilistic frameworks remains an open challenge. Communication-based proposals -- most notably the principles of impossibility of superluminal signaling and information causality (IC) -- highlight the role of communication in ruling out unphysical theories and offer an operational rationale on why quantum predictions prevail over these alternative models.
